summary: Nothing qualifies: after a full read of IDEAS.md/ideas.json (I-001..I-294) and INDEX.md, no inference-only idea that is new, lab-gateable on exp60/exp64 before 27 Sep 12:00 UTC and plausibly worth +0.012 lab exists; the edge term cannot reach +0.012 without retraining, and the only large per-embryo lever (retention guard, I-222) is already in the ledger and bounded at <= ~+0.011 even if fully causal.

findings.what: Edge-term arithmetic closes the fresh-eyes pass: +0.012 lab needs ~500 net FN fixes (29% of all 1,705 FN) or ~545 net FP removals (32% of all 1,681 FP) or ~260 net swap fixes, all at near-perfect precision. The measured ceilings per FN class are below that (swaps ~+0.006 as an oracle and judged not actionable; dangling ~+0.0003; node misses need recall arms that measured -0.013 to -0.03). The FP side is the edge-filter family, which scored 0 on the LB. Every fresh angle checked (hedge second-child edges, per-frame bipartite relink, AdaBN, density-adaptive radius or insertion, node-count bonus, z-shift, dedupe, linker window/TTA) maps to a ledger entry. Nothing reaches R8.

findings.what: Per-embryo check: the only large embryo-dependent mode switch acting on edges is x138's retention guard (I-222). It uses primary-only frames on 33.1% of 44b6 frames vs 3.9% of 6bba frames. GT-edge FN is 10.71% in primary-only frames vs 3.17% in blended frames, but frame difficulty confounds that gap. Even if forcing the blend were fully causal, the upper bound is ~+0.009 (44b6) + ~+0.002 (6bba) = <= ~+0.011 pooled. That is before the ~22% candidate loss that triggers the fallback, so the realistic sign is likely negative. It needs a GPU lab (logits not cached) and is a public-tuned knob. This is not a new idea. It stays post-deadline.
